items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I made it with a fellow named Elkins, and he had a big choir behind him.

ctx.x: It was Cecil Mack and Johnny Johnston Jones who introduced the Charleston in Running Wild, a show called Running Wild.

Uh-huh, well, Running -- yes, I remember Running Wild well. Let me see. Cecil Mack, you know, collaborated with Eubie Blake in writing a lot of his music, because he wrote -- oh, I remember the first record that was made with a choir. I made it with a fellow named Elkins, and he had a big choir behind him.
And I made -- what was that thing that Cecil Mack wrote? Lord, have mercy, what was that thing?
